newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile raises power generation prices 3.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chile raises power generation prices 3.8 pct.

text.p: Chile has increased electricity generating prices 3.8 percent with the new rates coming into force for six months from May, said National Energy Commission president Alejandro Jadresic.
The government had originally hoped that any rise in power generation costs as a result of this year's drought would be countered by the start-up of lower cost gas-fired plants mid-year.
But the unexpected severity of the drought forced the commission, Chile's equivalent of an energy ministry, to change its mind.
The drought, the worst in Chile this century, has slashed power output from dams which are Chile's main source of electricity. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
